description: Represents a layer in a wireframe page. Elements can be assigned to layers to control visibility, locking, and grouping.

members.name: IsLocked
members.description: When true, elements on this layer cannot be selected, moved, or edited.

members.name: IsVisible
members.description: When false, elements on this layer are hidden on the canvas.

members.name: Name
members.description: Display name shown in the Layers panel.

members.name: Order
members.description: Determines z-order / list order. Lower values render first.
